Galvanostatic charge−discharge of the material was carried out
at various rates over the voltage range of 0.8 to 2.6 V with
representative profiles shown in Figure 2B. On first discharge at
the slow rate of 0.1C (C = 1675 mA/gS), the material reaches
91% of theoretical capacity and visual distinction between the
two reaction plateaus, correlating to the peaks in Figure 2A, is
present.

1C is defined as a rate of 1675 mA/gS.
